title: Base change of an etale covering is an etale covering
statement: Let $(j_i:V_i\to Y)_{i\in I}$ be a family of etale morphisms of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism] which is jointly surjective (every point of $Y$ lies in the image of some $j_i$), and let $g:Y'\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the family of projections $(k_i:Y'\times_YV_i\to Y')_{i\in I}$ from the fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] consists of etale morphisms and is jointly surjective.
